pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Dew-Congealing Lingzhi grows beneath ancient trees and within damp, secluded woodland. Tiny droplets gather upon its smooth cap, lingering long after morning has passed. It favors shaded environments rich in moisture and natural spiritual energy.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Dark forests, old-growth pine and spruce taigas, jungles, and lush caves.
